lr_fra_algeria_campaign = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = LR_tt_algeria_campaign
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = LR_algeria_dmz
				NOT = { has_country_flag = LR_algeria_campaign }
			}
			set_country_flag = LR_algeria_campaign
			country_event = { id = lr_algeria.1 days = 25 }
		}
	}
}

lr_fra_algeria_pacify = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = LR_tt_algeria_pacify
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = LR_algeria_dmz }
				459 = { set_demilitarized_zone = no }
				460 = { set_demilitarized_zone = no }
				513 = { set_demilitarized_zone = no }
				514 = { set_demilitarized_zone = no }
				clr_country_flag = LR_algeria_dmz
				clr_country_flag = LR_algeria_campaign

				if = {
					limit = { has_idea = LR_FRA_algerian_crisis }
					remove_ideas = LR_FRA_algerian_crisis

				country_event = { id = lr_france.41 days = 5 }

		}
}
